notes.title: Patch Notes: SteamDeck support!
notes.notes:
Hey dancers!

We released a patch that updates controller support and also supports SteamDeck! You can read the full patch notes below.

Alongside this patch, The Song Editor is now accessible through a dedicated public branch where you can edit and create custom song choreography or create new ones! The branch is called "pcSongEditorIncluded".

Patch Notes

 Improved automatic support for auto-detection and button mapping of more major modern controllers.
 Improved button iconography for more major modern controllers.
 New support for plugging in a controller during gameplay and hot-swapping, including many related niceties.
  Press TAB on the Start Menu or Pause Menu to manually scan for newly plugged-in controllers.
 Disconnecting a controller during singleplayer play will automatically pause the game.
 Dropping a multiplayer controller during multiplayer play will now return to the controller-mapping screen, as will disconnecting at any point in multiplayer story, so controllers can be reassigned.   SteamDeck support is now added

- riv otter

notes.title: A Live Action Trailer! One Month 'Til Release!
notes.notes:
Monsters from Koras are invading the real world..!

Slay The Dance Floor Has a Date!!
August 30th! So soon!
I am pants-poopingly excited to dance this monster dance.

We've been trucking away, and we're awfully close to ready. In fact... The number of things in this expansion (because I'm never content to rest) has only grown!

 Full local multiplayer, across All play modes
 A new unlockable, playable character, with totally new ability types
 New unlockable passive abilities, usable in all modes
 Reworked and new challenges
 A brand new (still secret) play mode
 New languages, balance, tweaks, secrets

A giant, meaty, totally free expansion!

A Portal To Koras Has Opened!!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vsLKeoxM2jg
If there's ever been anything, in any universe, as cool as this trailer... I don't know what it is. Put it on loop and bask in it. I've been doing it all week.

And tell us what you think!

ːhugː   ːheartsongː  ːstoneheadː
-Danny

notes.title: Enhancement Patch Today
notes.notes:
Well... The first we've mentioned, at least...

New Features! More Incoming
Hey all! You may have noticed that there's been some quiet patches every day or two since launch. Thank you all for your Super Good ideas, suggestions, and bug notes on the forums! We appreciate them more than we can say!

To that end, since this lil' one makes some more visible changes, we thought we should spell out today's patch contents.
Note that the below also includes references to some changes made over the last week, that may already be in place in your current build.

New Features by Request:
[olist]
After much player demand, added a “Note Scroll Speed” slider to the Display Options menu.
This slider ranges from .5x to 4x.
As such, THEHUSTLE and SLOWJAMS cheat codes have been removed from the game.
GOTTAGOFAST enemy level was reduced by one.
Note: This tweak has been in place since just about the day GOTTAGOFAST was announced. We wanted the mode to be more speed than survival oriented.
[/olist]

Fixes/Tweaks:
[olist]
BigPharm Targeting is Smarter.
If all heroes are already Inspired/Protected, Gruver will target whoever has the least buff duration remaining.
Retribution now counts bleed damage toward its total.
This includes bleed damage accrued by cursed items.
Tagged a couple missed songs as YouTube unsafe that were at-first missed. Including the credits. (Sorry!)
Assorted fixes to minor forum-reported and unreported bugs.
Moderate redo of how note timing is handled in-engine, in preparation for more comprehensive upcoming enhancements.
You won't notice anything different yet. ;)
[/olist]

Woot!
Danny ːhugː ːstoneheadː
